result.reason: The redline adds the preferred 12-month software warranty and a professional-and-workmanlike services standard with re-performance/refund remedies, but it does not fully reach the playbook. It omits a compliance-with-laws warranty, retains an intent-limited malicious-code warranty covering only code that is “willfully introduced,” and provides no 90-day or 30-day warranty period for professional services. The uncapped services warranty and 12-month treatment of MarketSite.net Service may exceed the needed service duration. The new paragraph is also inserted after the incomplete lead-in “The warranty shall not apply only if:”, disrupting the exception structure and making the clause professionally deficient. Unrelated commercial provisions are otherwise preserved.
